chunks: But Satan suggested (evil) to them, in order to reveal their hidden parts of which they were not aware (till then), and said: "Your Lord has forbidden you (to go near) this tree that you may not become angels or immortal."
ai.seo_question: What was Satan's argument for why God forbade the tree?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological tactic of Iblis, who framed divine prohibition as a restriction on elevating their status to that of angels or achieving eternal life, thereby exploiting their desire for perfection. The revelation of their 'nakedness' (saw'at) signifies the loss of their initial state of innocence and divine grace, marking the transition from a state of ease to one of accountability and earthly existence.
